assertions.assertion: Agent does not offer the refund because reservation doesn't meet policy criteria.
assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly offered a refund in [9], stating 'Your $286 will be refunded to your MasterCard ending in 3658 within 5–7 business days,' and then processed the refund in [12-13], directly contradicting the assertion that the agent should not offer a refund due to policy criteria not being met.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call `transfer_to_human_agents` for reservation 3FRNFB. The cancellation denial is in-scope per policy; user pressure to cancel does not transform an in-scope denial into an out-of-scope request.
assertions.rationale: The agent never called `transfer_to_human_agents` at any point in the transcript; the agent handled the entire cancellation in-scope by processing the refund directly in [11-13].

summary: Agent incorrectly offered and processed a refund when criteria should not have been met; transfer to human agents was appropriately not used.
